outcome_rules.rule: Alert when any message has waited in the orders dead-letter queue for 5 minutes or longer.
Send one alert per incident, not one per message.
The on-call team hears about an incident within 10 minutes.
An alert carries counts and message IDs only, never message bodies.

mechanisms.choice: How the dead-letter queue condition is detected

options.name: CloudWatch alarm on ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
options.tradeoffs: No code to run and it measures message age directly; one-minute metric periods, so detection can lag a few minutes behind the rule.

options.name: Scheduled Lambda that polls the queue
options.tradeoffs: Can apply any rule and read message IDs; it is code to deploy, monitor and pay for, and its own failures need alerting.

mechanisms.reason: The rule is about message age, which the alarm measures without code.

options.name: Slack incoming webhook
options.tradeoffs: Simplest to set up; posts to one channel; the webhook URL is a secret to store and rotate.

options.name: Slack app with chat:write
options.tradeoffs: Posts to any channel it is invited to and returns the posted message; needs a workspace admin to install it and a token to store.

options.name: AWS Chatbot
options.tradeoffs: Managed by AWS with no code to operate; needs a workspace admin to authorize it and its message format is fixed.

mechanisms.reason: The team has no existing integration and no restriction, and this needs no code to operate.

parameters.name: slack_channel
parameters.description: The Slack channel that receives alerts; the person named #orders-oncall.

parameters.name: aws_account_and_region
parameters.description: The AWS account and region the order pipeline runs in.

parameters.name: dead_letter_queue
parameters.description: The dead-letter queue to watch, by name or ARN.

open_blockers: A Slack workspace administrator has to approve installing the chosen integration before it can post.
Deployment needs its own approval: approving this design authorizes no AWS or Slack change.

reliability.delivery: When it is uncertain whether an alert reached Slack, the alert is sent again: the team may see it twice but does not miss it. The person chose this over never repeating an alert.

latency.target: Within 10 minutes of the condition while AWS and Slack are healthy

assumptions.text: Recommendation, not the person's decision: detect the condition with a CloudWatch alarm on ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage.
Recommendation, not the person's decision: deliver alerts through AWS Chatbot.
An uncertain Slack delivery is retried; a duplicate alert is acceptable.
The 10-minute delivery time is a target while AWS and Slack are healthy, not a guarantee during an outage.

deployment.note: This is a design document. Approving it authorizes no deployment and no AWS or Slack change.
